Packaging-only Python dependencies, bundled to avoid downloads during a Mac build:

- ds_store 1.3.1 — https://github.com/dmgbuild/ds_store — MIT, included LICENSE.
- mac_alias 2.2.0 — https://github.com/dmgbuild/mac_alias — MIT, included mac_alias-LICENSE.

These sources are used only by the DMG builder, not shipped in Flow2Studio.app.
